name: Hertzian elastic contact theory
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 依据弹性接触变形计算接触法向力的理论。
usage_note: 本文法向力计算采用非线性Hertz关系，不能代替切向蠕滑力模型。
usage_overview: 常用于车辆—轨道耦合分析，由轮轨法向弹性压缩确定非线性法向接触力，也用作接触模型的比较基准。在满足局部曲率等假设的接触计算中，可用于求解椭圆接触斑，并作为条带计算的基础；其法向接触关系不能代替切向蠕滑力模型。

complete_examples.text: The wheel-rail interaction forces mainly include wheel– rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by the use of Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified by the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins nonlinear model (Shen et al. 1983).

The wheel-rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal direc-tions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by Kalker’s linear creep theory [19] and then modified with the Shen-Hedrick-Elkins nonlinear model [20].

The wheel–rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified with the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [40].

For the calculation of wheel-rail normal contact forces, the nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory is used to calculate the wheel-rail normal contact force, while the wheel-rail longitudinal and lateral creep forces are obtained based on the Kalker’s linear creep theory.
